_readme: The Magenta Forge layout. `npm run setup` shows what would change; `npm run setup:apply` makes it so and writes the IDs to config/discord-tiers.json. Run it again any time: nothing is duplicated. Access rules: gate (only people not yet verified), verified (every verified member), readonly (verified members read, staff write), staff, tier:<slug> (that tier and higher), role:<key> (that role and staff), league (Esports League role, teams, commissioners, staff). ambience:true lets the helper bots join a private voice room.

roles.name: Grand Elder
roles._note: Top of the list on purpose: only the server owner can give or take it. Opens every paid channel and the Elder Hall.
